# Phostide

> Free, MIT-licensed Windows 11 utility that paints OLED-safe animated themes into the real taskbar background (Explorer BackgroundFill), not a floating overlay.

Site: https://phostide.doticca.com
Source: https://github.com/teamdoticca/Phostide
Publisher: Doticca (https://doticca.com)

## Product

- Platform: Windows 11 22H2+ (x64)
- Mechanism: TAP helper paints the taskbar's own background fill; icons stay on top; quitting restores the normal bar
- Themes: Rainbow, Sea Waves, Weather, Space, Aurora
- Privacy: local only — no account, no telemetry, no network required to run
- Distribution: signed Setup.exe (per-user, no admin) and portable zip via GitHub Releases
